name: LDV eDeliver 9
description:
LIFT YOUR GAME!

ELECTRIC TRUCK AT DIESEL TRUCK PRICE.

MORE PAYLOAD. LOWER RUNNING COSTS.

Introducing the LDV eDeliver 9, Australia's lightest 4.5-tonne electric Pantech truck, combining exceptional payload capacity, outstanding value for money and the benefits of zero-emission transport.

Cheaper than Japanese Euro 6 diesel trucks, with more payload and significantly lower running costs.

Built for Australian businesses, the eDeliver 9 combines modern electric vehicle technology with DROPTRUCK's lightweight body engineering, delivering a practical, work-ready solution that helps businesses carry more and spend less.

Forget expensive diesel, rising fuel costs and costly engine maintenance. Make the switch to electric and put those savings straight back into your business.

CUT YOUR FUEL COSTS. BUILD YOUR PROFITS.

Why pay more for a diesel truck when you can drive electric for less?

Available through SKYEV, complete with an Australian-manufactured DROPTRUCK body and ready to work.
specs: Up to 235 km WLTP (small box configuration)
